description: Curated theme/component availability changes for surface interpretation. Source links are the release notes.

10.6.x.notes: Drupal 10 standard profile uses Olivero front end and Claro admin theme.

11.4.x.notes: Drupal 11 includes Olivero; Default Admin is present in the 11.4 target.

12.0.x.notes: Drupal 12 removes Olivero and other front-end themes; treat Olivero-only issues as out of scope for 12.x targets.
